title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before placing tables, chairs or other furniture on a footpath, road or other public land for outdoor dining.

sources.title: City of Darwin By-laws 2023
sources.quote: A person must not, without an authorisation, place goods or equipment in, on or over public land, or outside premises adjoining public land.

sources.title: Outdoor dining permit city of darwin
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this permit if you intend to place tables and chairs on the footpath outside a restaurant or cafe.
